name: Jesus Points To God The Father
overview: Jesus consistently directs believers to God the Father as the ultimate source of reward, forgiveness, and provision, emphasizing a personal and reverent relationship with Him. In teaching His disciples to pray, Jesus begins with 'Our Father which art in heaven,' highlighting God's holiness and fatherly care. He further reveals that access to the Father comes exclusively through Himself, declaring that no one comes to the Father except by Him. This underscores the unchanging nature of Jesus Christ as the mediator between God and humanity.
